aurelian: Solenne the Radiant, Sun-Queen of the fictional Aurelian Dominion: a regal woman in her forties with warm bronze skin, piercing amber eyes and a knowing half-smile, black hair in a crown of braids beneath a tall radiant golden sun-disc diadem, draped in cloth-of-gold robes over deep burnt-umber brown, golden pauldrons shaped as sun rays, a jewelled crown pendant at her throat; behind her a colossal golden wonder under construction glows through dusk haze and a huge sun emblem burns softly in the darkness. Costume colours: rich gold and deep burnt-umber brown.
thalassan: Kaelo Tidewarden, Grand Admiral of the fictional Thalassan League: a broad-shouldered island merchant-prince in his thirties with deep brown skin, swirling teal sea tattoos on his arms and neck, salt-streaked long black hair tied back, a confident weathered grin, wearing a deep navy admiral's longcoat with turquoise silk sash, silver pearl clasps and a silver anchor pendant, one hand on a spyglass; behind him a great harbour of teal sails and a lighthouse beam cutting through sea-spray, a glowing silver anchor emblem in the dark. Costume colours: turquoise teal and deep navy.
varkhan: Ulzai Khagan of the fictional Varkhan Horde: a fierce steppe warlord in his fifties, weathered tan skin, sharp dark eyes narrowed against the wind, long black moustache and braided hair with silver beads, wearing crimson lamellar armour trimmed with wolf fur and a tall fur-crowned iron helm, a curved sabre over his shoulder, a golden horsehead brooch; behind him a thundering cavalry charge silhouetted against a blood-red sunset and a crossed-swords emblem glowing faintly. Costume colours: blood crimson and near-black oxblood.
sylvaran: Myrrh of the Thousand Boughs, Elder Warden of the fictional Sylvaran Wilds: an ageless, serene forest elder with bark-textured olive skin, long silver-green hair woven with leaves and tiny white flowers, calm glowing emerald eyes, wearing flowing moss-green and deep forest robes with living ivy, a crown of antler-like branches, a wise owl perched on one shoulder; behind her colossal ancient trees with a city grown from living wood, fireflies drifting, an owl emblem glowing faintly in the canopy dark. Costume colours: leaf green and deep forest green.
ashkari: Zahirah Sunveil, Sultana of the fictional Ashkari Sultanate: a striking desert queen in her thirties with deep olive-brown skin and kohl-lined eyes, a sheer burnt-orange silk veil thrown back over a jewelled headdress of gold coins, wearing layered saffron-orange and dark cinnamon-brown silks with a golden serpent armlet coiling up her arm, a caravan dagger at her sash; behind her moonlit dunes, a camel caravan and domed palaces under a sky of stars, a coiled serpent emblem glowing faintly. Costume colours: saffron orange and dark cinnamon brown.
kethran: Ilven Starquill, Archmagister of the fictional Kethran Archive: an elderly scholar-mage with pale skin, a sharp clever face, silver beard braided with violet ribbon and bright curious violet eyes behind brass spectacles, wearing deep indigo and amethyst-violet robes embroidered with constellations, a glowing crystal flask in one hand and a quill tucked behind the ear; behind them a tower of glass and brass orreries under a starry night, an open-book emblem glowing faintly. Costume colours: amethyst violet and deep indigo.
morvane: Brask Ironhand, Iron Duke of the fictional Morvane Forgeholds: a massive barrel-chested mountain smith in his fifties with ruddy pale skin, soot-streaked face, fierce grey eyes and a thick copper-red beard braided with iron rings, a mechanical iron gauntlet for a right hand, wearing heavy steel-blue plate armour with riveted gear motifs over a leather smith's apron, glowing forge-orange light reflecting on the metal; behind him the fiery mouths of mountain forges and a shield emblem glowing faintly. Costume colours: steel blue-grey and forge orange.
celestine: Isara the Veiled, High Oracle of the fictional Celestine Veil: a mysterious young prophetess with luminous dark skin, her eyes glowing softly with starlight, a translucent pale-pink veil embroidered with tiny stars draped over her head, wearing flowing magenta-rose and pearl-white robes, a jewelled all-seeing-eye circlet on her brow, one hand raised holding a small glowing comet; behind her a night sky streaked with a great comet and a spire of seers, a star emblem glowing faintly. Costume colours: magenta rose and pearl white.
